title: All The Catalytic Active Sites of MoS 2 for Hydrogen Evolution

extraction_issues.quote: The turnover frequencies (Tafel slopes) of the edge sites, sulfur vacancies, and grain boundaries are estimated to be $ 1 5 \mathrm{s}^{-1} $ $ (6 5-7 5 \mathrm{m V / d e c}) $ $ 6. 3 \mathrm{s}^{-1} $ $ (6 5-8 5 \mathrm{m V / d e c}) $ , and $ 0. 2 \mathrm{s}^{-1} $ $ (1 2 0-1 6 0 \mathrm{m V / d e c}) $ , respectively.
extraction_issues.reason: 摘要中 TOF 与 Tafel 斜率之间缺少逗号或连接词，导致三个位点的数值对应关系在文本上不清晰；正文第 4 页有更明确的对应表述。

extraction_issues.quote: The turnover frequency (TOF) of the edge sites, sulfur vacancies, and grain boundaries are quantitatively evaluated to be $ 1 5 \pm 3 \mathrm{s}^{-1} $ $ 6. 3 \pm 0. 8 \mathrm{s}^{-1} $ , and around $ 0. 2 \mathrm{s}^{-1} $ , respectively.
extraction_issues.reason: 三个 TOF 数值之间缺少逗号，但数值本身可辨，不影响理解。

extraction_issues.quote: We can find the Tafel slope and exchange current density by fitting the Tafel plots to the equation of $ \eta=\rho\log (j)+\log (j_{0}) $ , where $ \eta $ is the overpotential (vs. RHE), $ j_{0} $ the exchange current density, and $ \rho $ the Tafel slope $ ^{3 2} $
extraction_issues.reason: 公式中 log(j0) 前缺少系数，通常 Tafel 方程应为 η = ρ log(j) + ρ log(j0) 或 η = a + b log(j)，但此处照录原文可见形式，不擅自补写。

extraction_issues.quote: with exchange current densities in the range of $ 3 0-6 0 \ \mu\mathrm{A/cm^{2}} $ and Tafel slopes in the range of 65-75 meV/dec.
extraction_issues.reason: Tafel 斜率单位应为 mV/dec，此处 OCR 为 meV/dec，与全文其他处及摘要一致写法不符。

extraction_issues.quote: Figure 4. Quantitative evaluation for the catalytic activities of each active site. (a) XPS results for monolayer $ \mathrm{M o S_{2}} $ films with different densities of sulfur vacancies. (b) Polarization curve of the $ \mathrm{M o S_{2}} $ films with different densities of sulfur vacancies. (b) Exchange current densities (upper) and Tafel slopes of the films as a function of the density of sulfur vacancies. The dashed lines serve to guide the vision. (c) Exchange current densities (upper) and Tafel slopes of the $ \mathrm{M o S_{2}} $ flakes as a function of the edge length per unit area.
extraction_issues.reason: 图注中 (b) 出现两次，且 (c) 与正文中 Fig. 4c 和 Fig. 4d 的对应关系混乱，可能为 OCR 抽取时图注子图编号错位。

extraction_issues.quote: while the title grain boundary is not catalytically active.
extraction_issues.reason: 结合上下文应为 tilt grain boundary（倾斜晶界），OCR 误为 title grain boundary。

extraction_issues.quote: Briefly molybdenum chloride $ (\mathrm{M o C l}{5}) $ powder (99.99% Sigma-Aldrich) was placed at the center of the furnace
extraction_issues.reason: 化学式 MoCl5 的下标 5 在 OCR 中丢失，显示为 MoCl{5} 或 MoCl5 不完整。

extraction_issues.quote: Monolayer $ \mathrm{M o S{2}} $ flakes were grown using a different chemical vapor deposition $ (\mathrm{C V D})^{6} $ , in which $ \mathrm{M o O_{3}} $ $ (99.99\% $ Sigma-Aldrich) instead of $ \mathrm{M o C l_{5}} $ was used as the precursor.
extraction_issues.reason: MoS2 的化学式下标 2 在 OCR 中丢失，显示为 MoS{2}。

extraction_issues.quote: All computations in this work were performed with the plane-wave software code VASP (Vienne ab initio simulation package) $ ^{37} $
extraction_issues.reason: VASP 全称应为 Vienna ab initio simulation package，OCR 误为 Vienne。

self_check: 已核对摘要、正文和结论中的关键数值：边缘位点 TOF 15 ± 3 s−1、Tafel 斜率 65–75 mV/dec；硫空位 TOF 6.3 ± 0.8 s−1、Tafel 斜率 65–85 mV/dec；晶界 TOF 约 0.2 s−1、Tafel 斜率 120–160 mV/dec；硫空位最优密度 7–10%，交换电流密度 30–60 μA/cm2；薄膜交换电流密度 40 μA/cm2 vs. 薄片 3.5 μA/cm2；修复后薄膜交换电流密度从 30.1 μA/cm2 降至 1 μA/cm2，Tafel 斜率从 70 升至 125 mV/dec；无空位合并薄膜交换电流密度 0.04 μA/cm2，Tafel 斜率约 160 mV/dec；Table 1 吸附自由能数值已逐项核对。公式 η = ρ log(j) + log(j0) 照录原文，未补写可能缺失的系数。仍不确定之处：图注子图编号存在 OCR 错位，但正文对 Fig. 4c 和 Fig. 4d 的描述可辅助理解；MoCl5 和 MoS2 下标在部分位置丢失，已按可见文本保留。
